import json,collections
calls=json.loads('${JSON.stringify(cs)}'); pre=json.loads('${JSON.stringify(ps)}'); extras=json.loads('${JSON.stringify(ex)}')
items=[json.loads(l) for l in open('items.jsonl')]
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for n,(x,c,p) in enumerate(zip(items,calls,pre),1):
  f.write(json.dumps(dict(item_id=x['item_id'],slots={str(i+1):a for i,a in enumerate(c)},confidence={str(i+1):('low' if n==19 else 'high') for i in range(len(c))},unmarked_final_hard_signs=extras.get(str(n),[]),pre1918=p,note=('Lower part of line clipped; stem top has no left flag.' if n==19 else '')),ensure_ascii=False)+'
')
answers=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(answers)==len(items)
for x,a in zip(items,answers):
 assert x['item_id']==a['item_id']
 expected={str(i+1) for i in range(x['slots'])}
 assert set(a['slots'])==expected
 assert set(a['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(v in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for v in a['slots'].values())
 assert all(v in ['high','low'] for v in a['confidence'].values())
 assert a['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
counts=collections.Counter(v for a in answers for v in a['slots'].values())
print('Validated count, order, and slot coverage:',len(answers),'items')
print('Slot calls:',dict(counts))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(a['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for a in answers))
